items.subject: Live wrong link: mexican-chorizo-fresh Walmart See-item opened the BEEF chorizo the new \bbeef\b exclude released, and no link guard saw it
evidence: public/board.json at 92f2cfa7c: mexican-chorizo-fresh Walmart chip $2.68/lb (Cacique Pork Chorizo, 9 oz, item 11027816, $1.50, 0.56 lb) with href https://www.walmart.com/ip/10451933; product-urls.json named that url 'Cacique Beef Chorizo 12oz' (price 1.5, 0.75 lb, verified 2026-08-31 price-pull self-capture)

why no guard fired: audit-name-drift shares brand (Cacique) and product word (chorizo) so no token/brand/product mismatch; the link per-unit 2.00 vs board 2.68 is a 0.747 ratio, inside the factor rule (0.67..1.5), so prune-bad-links kept it and audit-tile-integrity graded it PRICE-DRIFT (warn), never WRONG-PRODUCT

why nothing re-derived it: derive-links-from-prices runs in check-ad-cycles and apply-coverage-batch's repair path only; the plan-9 hand chain (compare-deals, name-drift, prune, overrides, build, guards) never runs it, and add-known-wrong's scoped re-check fires on a known-wrong ruling, not on an exclude

class size measured over the live product-urls.json: 33 of 2,962 stored links name a product their own commodity's effective excludes refuse (e.g. grapefruit|Fareway 'Carbliss Grapefruit Vodka Cocktail', cherries|Family Fare 'Sweet Cherry Brats (4 Ct.)', chicken-thighs|Walmart 'Tyson Fresh Chicken Drumstick, 10 lb Bag', plums|Fareway 'Fareway Red Plum Jelly')
items.root_cause: An exclude is a ruling that releases products from a commodity, but the link layer only heard about known-wrong rulings. A link keyed on commodity|store survives its product leaving the cell, and the only identity checks (name-drift token/brand/product tests, the 0.67..1.5 factor band) cannot see a same-brand, same-noun product in another variant.

root_fix.what: grocery/commodity-rules-lib.ps1 gains Add-TcRuleIndex / Get-TcReleasingPattern (the commodity's effective excludes via Get-TcCommodityExclude). derive-links-from-prices drops every link whose stored name its own commodity refuses, alongside the known-wrong drop, then re-derives from the row the board prices (new -CommoditiesFile pin). The trigger runs where an exclude is applied: apply-coverage-batch re-checks every touched commodity (derive -Commodity <id> -Apply) after its rebuild, and audit-match-soundness -Accept re-checks every commodity that lost a name between the old and new baseline. The guard gap: audit-name-drift flags such a link 'rule-released', so prune-bad-links drops it in the chain and audit-tile-integrity counts it WRONG-PRODUCT (a hard accuracy fault) if it ever ships.
